# Chinese Mountains

> An independent guide to every famous peak in China. Interactive maps, detailed guides, comparison tools, and a 3-step quiz to help travelers find their perfect mountain. 37 mountains across 7 regions, with elevation, difficulty, best season, UNESCO status, ticket prices, and cultural context for each peak.

## Key Pages

- [Home](https://www.chinese-mountains.com/): Interactive decision engine — search, map, and quiz to match travelers with mountains
- [Explore All Mountains](https://www.chinese-mountains.com/explore/): Browse and filter all 37 mountains by region, difficulty, and vibe
- [Best Mountains Ranking](https://www.chinese-mountains.com/best/): Ranked list of the best Chinese mountains with scores and reviews
- [Compare Mountains Tool](https://www.chinese-mountains.com/compare/): Side-by-side comparison of elevation, difficulty, prices, and ratings
- [Travel Guides](https://www.chinese-mountains.com/guides/): Seasonal and difficulty-based travel planning guides
- [Photo Gallery](https://www.chinese-mountains.com/gallery/): Curated photography of all covered mountains
- [Collections](https://www.chinese-mountains.com/collections/): Themed groups — Five Great Mountains, Buddhist peaks, Daoist peaks
- [Blog](https://www.chinese-mountains.com/blog/): Trip reports and in-depth articles
- [About](https://www.chinese-mountains.com/about/): Mission, team, and editorial standards
- [Contact](https://www.chinese-mountains.com/contact/): Corrections, feedback, and partnership inquiries

## Mountain Detail Pages

Each mountain has a dedicated page with elevation, difficulty, best season, highlights, cultural significance, transport routes, ticket prices, and FAQs. URL pattern: /mountains/{slug}/

- [Mount Huangshan](https://www.chinese-mountains.com/mountains/huangshan/): Granite pinnacles and the famous sea of clouds, UNESCO site
- [Zhangjiajie](https://www.chinese-mountains.com/mountains/zhangjiajie/): Sandstone pillars that inspired Avatar's floating mountains
- [Mount Tai](https://www.chinese-mountains.com/mountains/taishan/): Most storied of the Five Great Mountains, imperial sacrifice site
- [Mount Hua](https://www.chinese-mountains.com/mountains/huashan/): Extreme cliff-face Plank Walk, western mountain of the Wuyue
- [Mount Emei](https://www.chinese-mountains.com/mountains/emeishan/): Sacred Buddhist mountain, world's tallest bronze Buddha
- [Mount Everest](https://www.chinese-mountains.com/mountains/everest/): North-face views of the world's highest peak from Tibet
- [Jade Dragon Snow Mountain](https://www.chinese-mountains.com/mountains/jade-dragon/): Glaciers above Lijiang, cable car to 4,506m
- [Mount Wutai](https://www.chinese-mountains.com/mountains/wutaishan/): Bodhisattva seat of Manjushri, 360+ temples
- [Meili Snow Mountain](https://www.chinese-mountains.com/mountains/meili-snow/): Sacred unclimbed Kawagarbo peak, golden sunrise views
- [Guilin Karst](https://www.chinese-mountains.com/mountains/guilin/): Iconic limestone peaks along the Li River
- [Wudang Mountains](https://www.chinese-mountains.com/mountains/wudang/): Daoist temple complex and martial-arts heritage
- [Mount Sanqing](https://www.chinese-mountains.com/mountains/sanqingshan/): Daoist granite peaks with cliff walkways
- [Tianmen Mountain](https://www.chinese-mountains.com/mountains/tianmen/): The Heaven's Gate arch and the 99-bend road
- [Mount Siguniang](https://www.chinese-mountains.com/mountains/siguniang/): The "Queen of Sichuan's mountains," alpine trekking
- [Tianshan Mountains](https://www.chinese-mountains.com/mountains/tianshan/): Xinjiang's snow-capped spine, Tianchi lake
- [Mount Song](https://www.chinese-mountains.com/mountains/songshan/): Shaolin Temple and the central mountain of the Wuyue
- [Mount Heng, Hunan](https://www.chinese-mountains.com/mountains/hengshan-hunan/): Southern mountain of the Wuyue, pilgrimage routes
- [Mount Heng, Shanxi](https://www.chinese-mountains.com/mountains/hengshan-shanxi/): Northern mountain, Hanging Temple
- [Mount Fanjing](https://www.chinese-mountains.com/mountains/fanjing/): UNESCO site with the Red Clouds Golden Summit temples
- [Mount Gongga](https://www.chinese-mountains.com/mountains/gongga/): The "King of Sichuan's mountains," 7,556m glacier giant
- [Namcha Barwa](https://www.chinese-mountains.com/mountains/namcha-barwa/): 7,782m peerless peak above the Yarlung Tsangpo bend
- [Mount Kailash](https://www.chinese-mountains.com/mountains/kailash/): Sacred to four religions, 52km pilgrim kora
- [Changbai Mountain](https://www.chinese-mountains.com/mountains/changbai/): Volcanic crater lake Tianchi on the Korean border
- [Mount Lu](https://www.chinese-mountains.com/mountains/lushan/): UNESCO summer resort mountain of poets and mist
- [Mount Wuyi](https://www.chinese-mountains.com/mountains/wuyi/): UNESCO bamboo raft gorges and tea culture
- [Jiuhua Mountain](https://www.chinese-mountains.com/mountains/jiuhuashan/): Sacred Buddhist mountain of Ksitigarbha
- [Putuo Mountain](https://www.chinese-mountains.com/mountains/putuoshan/): Island sanctuary of Guanyin, sacred Buddhist mountain
- [Qingcheng Mountain](https://www.chinese-mountains.com/mountains/qingcheng/): Birthplace of Daoism, serene temple trails
- [Danxia Mountain](https://www.chinese-mountains.com/mountains/danxia/): Namesake of the UNESCO Danxia landform, red sandstone
- [Haba Snow Mountain](https://www.chinese-mountains.com/mountains/haba-snow/): 5,396m climbable snow peak beside Tiger Leaping Gorge
- [Cangshan Mountain](https://www.chinese-mountains.com/mountains/cangshan/): Marble peaks above Dali's old town and Erhai lake
- [Kanas Lake & Mountains](https://www.chinese-mountains.com/mountains/kanas/): Alpine lake and Tuva villages in Altai forests
- [Hailuogou Glacier](https://www.chinese-mountains.com/mountains/hailuogou/): Low-latitude glacier valley below Mount Gongga
- [Yandang Mountain](https://www.chinese-mountains.com/mountains/yandang/): Night-view granite peaks and waterfalls in Zhejiang
- [Mingsha Dunes](https://www.chinese-mountains.com/mountains/mingsha/): Singing sand dunes and Crescent Moon Spring near Dunhuang
- [Laojun Mountain](https://www.chinese-mountains.com/mountains/laojun/): Golden-roofed Daoist temples on cliffs near Luoyang
- [Shilin Stone Forest](https://www.chinese-mountains.com/mountains/shilin/): Karst stone forest near Kunming, UNESCO site

## Data Coverage

37 mountains across 7 regions of China, including elevations, difficulty ratings, seasonal recommendations, UNESCO status, and cultural significance. Data is verified against UNESCO documentation, official scenic-area announcements, and editorial field notes.
